title: Malloy and Florio-Marinello receive NEC weekly cross country honors
text:
Malloy and Florio-Marinello receive NEC weekly cross country honors
By
M. N. ReedFifth-year runner Jordan Malloy and freshman Kyra Florio-Marinello were named Northeast Conference weekly award winners, the League announced on Sep. 16.
Malloy was selected as the NEC Athlete of the Week after placing third at Bryant's Shawn M. Nassaney Invitational. She ran a 5:56.2-minute mile and finished with a time of 18:28.5.
Florio-Marinello earned NEC Rookie of the Week recognition for being the top freshman finisher at the same meet, coming in 15th overall with a time of 18:54.7.
Sophomore Isabella Galusha also received NEC Prime Performer honors by finishing in 12th place, recording a time of 18:49.3.
Stonehill is scheduled to compete next at the UMass Dartmouth Invitational on Saturday, September 19, at noon.
